title: Jachʼa Uma Juiciot yatiyiri
intro: Aka jaqix patak patak maranakaw aguantañatakix mä pilar ukhamaw sayt’asiwayi, mä jan yäqasir sociedad ukar chiqa qhanar jawsañataki, ukampirus jisk’achasiñamp jan yäqañampiw uñjasi. Walja jan waltʼäwinakas utjkchïnsa ukat walja maranakan mä yatiyäwijj wali chʼamäkchïnsa, uka uywatajj qhep qhepa decreto apsuñkamajj misionerjam jan saytʼasïnwa.
clues: Nayax llätunk patak phisqa tunk maraw markajarux chiqa thakin jawst’ayäta, uruy arumaw, jamasat ukhamarak jaqinak nayraqatan.
Nayajj markajaruw mä tʼaqhesiñ mutuyäwit ewjjtʼayäta, ukampis jupanakajj amparanakap jinchuparuw uchasipjjäna, jachʼa jachʼa tukusaw isimp isthaptʼasipjjäna.
Nayarojj Tatitujan uñjat nayranakapan mä jachʼa kun lurañajatakiw mayïna, janis umajj uñjaskäna ukhasa.
Trabajkayäta ukhajja, markajan pʼeqtʼirinakapajj pasawayasaw sawkasipjjetäna, ukampis niyaw jupanakat sawkasiñäni sasaw sista.
Naya pachpaw jañchijampi wilajampi nayamp chikt’atäñapatak achikt’asiyäta, ukampis jupanakax mä qullun imantasiñ amtapxäna, ukax jilxattaskir umax qhispiyani sasaw amuyapxäna.
Qhepatjja, oraqejj umap manqʼantjjäna ukat alajjpachajj janiw jallu purjjänti, ukatwa barcojajj Judí qollun samartʼjjäna.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
